references: As nove primeiras fotos seguem a ordem dos alunos. Extras 160003 = Pedro; 160007 = Luis Martins. Fotografias pessoais não incluídas no repositório.
commonPrompt: Production pixel art top-down RPG O Segredo de Varginha. Preserve photo identity and specified outfit. Transparent alpha, deliberate square pixels, dark outline, consistent head/body proportions. Movement: south, west, east, north, four walk frames. Two attacks: anticipation, contact, recovery, east and west plus detached small/large effects. No text, grids, background or floor shadows. Inspect generated coordinates; pack with nearest-neighbor, complete bodies, fixed foot baseline, preserve GUIDs.
